title: Slow English Podcast #297: Gyeongju - South Korea 🇰🇷

sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas. Today, we travel
to Asia. We go to South Korea. Our city today is Jeongju. Jeongju is calm. Jeongju is historic.
Jeongju is full of tradition and nature. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our
journey together. Part two, South Korea and Asia. South Korea is a country in East Asia. It is a
modern country. It is also a very old country. South Korea has big cities. South Korea has small
towns. South Korea has mountains and sea. Many people know Seoul. Many people know K-pop.
But today, we visit Jeongju. Jeongju shows the old Korea. It shows history and tradition.
Part three, where is Jeongju? Jeongju is in the east of South Korea. It is not far from the sea.
The city is not very big. It is quiet and open. There are hills and fields around the city.
Nature is close. Life feels slow here. Jeongju is easy to walk. Many places are near each other.
Part four, weather and seasons. Jeongju has four seasons. Spring is soft and green.
Flowers bloom in parks. Summer is warm and wet. The sun is strong. Autumn is cool and colorful.
Leaves turn red and yellow. Winter is cold but calm. Sometimes there is snow.
People change life with the seasons. Part five, an ancient capital.
Jeongju was an ancient capital. Long ago, it was the capital of the Silla Kingdom.
This was more than 1,000 years ago. Kings and queens lived here. The city was rich and powerful.
Art and culture grew here. Today, you can still feel this past. History lives in the city.
Part six, royal tombs. Jeongju has many royal tombs. They look like green hills. Kings and
queens rest there. The tombs are quiet. People walk around them slowly. They respect the past.
The tombs are part of daily life. They are in parks and open areas.
Part seven, bulguksa temple. One famous place is bulguksa temple. It is very old. It is very beautiful.
The temple is in the mountains. Trees surround it. People come to pray. People come to relax.
The air feels calm. The place feels peaceful and deep.
Part eight, selkuram grotto near bulguksa. There is selkuram grotto. Inside, there is a stone Buddha.
The Buddha is calm and strong. The face is peaceful. People speak softly here.
Many people feel calm inside. It is a spiritual place. It is very important in Korea.
Part nine, daily life in Jeongju. Daily life in Jeongju is slow. People wake up early.
They work and study. They take walks. In the evening, families meet. They eat together.
They talk quietly. Life is simple. Life is balanced. Life feels peaceful. Part 10, food in Jeongju.
Food in Jeongju is traditional. People eat rice every day. They eat soup and vegetables.
They eat fish and meat. Kimchi is very common. Food is healthy and warm.
People share food. Eating together is important. Part 11, nature and parks.
Jeongju has many parks. Grass is green. Trees are everywhere. People walk and ride bikes.
Children play. Nature is part of the city. History and nature live together.
The city feels open and calm. Part 12, feeling tradition and goodbye.
Jeongju is a city of ancient history, temples, royal tombs, nature and slow life. It is not loud.
